title: Usage billing beyond the weekly quota: what a tenant pays when it uses more (commercial and engineering)
description:
Outcome: Owner decision C (Ryan, 2026-11-08): usage beyond the quota should be billable; Prospectus has no overage billing today (billing is a plan per deployment; the weekly quota stops at 100%). Commercial: how overage is priced (per unit of the private cost ledger with a margin), whether a tenant sets its own monthly ceiling, how it is shown (customers see percent of quota, never rates), and what happens at the ceiling (owner decision 10 default: model work stops, serving and editing continue). Engineering in Prospectus: overage metered from the cost ledger (kanbus-bb0b6c) into invoice lines per period per deployment, through the billing ledger and later Stripe; quota check answers 'over quota but allowed' when the tenant opted in. Papyrus side: the spend gate (PPY-889ab5) treats 'allowed overage' as allowed and shows it.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): Prospectus: docs/BILLING.md, docs/QUOTA.md, docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md; Papyrus: PPY-889ab5, the newsroom usage panel.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/model-spend-ceiling.feature (overage scenarios)):
Scenario: A tenant that opted in keeps working past its quota and is billed for it
    Given alpha opted in to overage up to a monthly ceiling
    When it passes 100% of this week's quota
    Then model work continues, the overage appears as a priced line on the next invoice, and work stops at the ceiling

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-6d9a6d, PPY-25e0d7. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-89c4f0.

Testing: Prospectus billing specs; Papyrus Behave with a fake quota server.
Rollout: After cost accounting runs on real sites.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a surprise bill. Mitigation: opt-in, a ceiling the tenant sets, notices at 80% and 100%.

Releasable on its own: yes, in Prospectus.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
